welcome.heading: Find the Right PrEP Option for You
welcome.subheading: Learn, compare, and decide which PrEP method fits your life
welcome.description: PrEP (pre-exposure prophylaxis) is a safe and highly effective way to prevent HIV. Today there are more options than ever: a daily pill, a pill before and after sex, an injection every 2 months, or an injection every 6 months. This tool will help you explore each option, think about what matters most to you, and feel confident talking to your provider about the best fit for your life.

steps.title: Learn
steps.description: Get the facts about each PrEP option: how it works, what to expect, and what's involved.

steps.title: Compare
steps.description: See your options side by side so you can easily spot the differences that matter to you.

steps.title: Reflect
steps.description: Answer a few simple questions about your preferences, lifestyle, and what's important to you.

steps.title: Decide
steps.description: Get a personalized summary to help guide your conversation with your healthcare provider.

welcome.disclaimer: This tool does not collect or store any personal health information. Your answers are used only during this session to generate your personalized results and are not saved or shared.
